title: 第1110 章 以后就是大哥第1110 章 以后就是大哥
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: 神芒穿透层层空间，无声无息的落在秦关身上，想要将秦关里里外外看个通透。
然而就在神芒触及秦关的刹那，一股极其古老的气息从他体内苏醒。
那气息将知命的神通轻轻一挡。
知命浑身一震，双目之中神芒溃散，整个人不受控制的向后踉跄了两步：“那小子体内……有东西，居然能阻挡本神的神照！”
白袍老者闻言大惊失色：“殿主？您看到了什么？”
知命没有立刻回答，他缓缓直起身，沉默了很久才说了一句：“他的身体里，藏着一件连我都看不透的东西。”
白袍老者神色骤变：“连殿主您都看不透？”
知命眼神一凝：“速速派人去查下这人！”
白袍老者不敢怠慢，转身朝密室外走去。
只是白袍老者没走两步突然停下脚步，在他的前方，突然出现了一名身穿蓝色碎花裙的小姑娘。
看到林岁岁，知命和白袍老者有些诧异，她怎么会来这里？
“那青年是我的猎物。”
林岁岁脸上挂着温和的笑容看向知命。
知命眉头轻蹙：“他是什么人？”
林岁岁吧唧了下小嘴巴：“他是什么人不重要，重要的是，他能让我吃到更多的炸鸡肉，谁不让我吃炸鸡，我就吃谁。”
知命沉默。
林岁岁的话很明显，那青年是他的猎物，若是插手她就翻脸。
过了片刻他摆手一笑：“既是你的猎物，那便不插手了。”
林岁岁听完什么也没说，消失在密室。
林岁岁走后，白袍老者看向知命沉声道：“殿主，这道灵是越来越放肆了，她现在完全不把咱们天命神殿放在眼里。”
知命轻蔑一笑：“养大了的宠物而已，纵有几分野性，主子永远是他主子。”
白袍老者点头有些好奇道：
“殿主，您之前说那小子身上有什么宝物阻挡了神照，那道灵会不会盯上他的宝物了？”
“有这个可能。”
知命微微颔首诧异道：“能将神照挡下，说明那宝物很不一般。”
知命说着眉头逐渐皱了起来，他的脑海里不禁浮现出秦关的长相：
“能进万妖塔，说明那小子的年纪不超过千载，在这个年纪能击杀道始境的妖兽，放眼整个神殿年轻一辈，也不过三人能做到，以他的能力，不应该在下界才对。”
“殿主，那咱们还要去查那小子的来历吗？”白袍老者小声问。
知命轻哼了声：“自然要查，眼下神主在闭关，不能明着来，若是激怒了那道灵会引来不必要的麻烦。”
知命说着目光微沉：“让顺天商会的人暗中去办吧，查查那青年到底是何人。”
白袍老者心领神会：“属下明白，这就去安排。”
content_en:
The divine light penetrated through the layers of space and fell silently on Qinguan, trying to see through Qinguan inside and outside.
However, the moment the divine light touched Qin Guan, an extremely ancient breath awakened from his body.
That breath gently blocked Zhi Ming's magical power.
Zhi Ming's whole body was shocked, the divine light in his eyes disappeared, and he stumbled back two steps uncontrollably: "There is... something in that kid's body that can actually block the divine light of this god!"
The old man in white robe was shocked when he heard this: "Palace Master? What did you see?"
Zhiming didn't answer immediately. He slowly straightened up and said after a long silence: "There is something hidden in his body that even I can't see through."
The expression of the old man in white robe suddenly changed: "You can't even see through the palace master?"
Zhiming's eyes narrowed: "Send someone quickly to check this person!"
"Yes!"
The old man in white robe did not dare to neglect, turned around and walked towards the secret room.
But the old man in white robe suddenly stopped before taking two steps. In front of him, a little girl wearing a blue floral skirt suddenly appeared.
Seeing Lin Suisui, Zhi Ming and the old man in white robe were a little surprised. Why did she come here?
"That young man is my prey."
Lin Suisui looked at Zhiming with a gentle smile on his face.
Zhiming frowned slightly: "Who is he?"
Lin Suisui clicked his tongue and said, "It doesn't matter who he is. What's important is that he can let me eat more fried chicken. I will eat whoever doesn't let me eat fried chicken."
Know your fate and be silent.
Lin Suisui's words made it obvious that the young man was his prey, and she would fall out if he interfered.
After a moment, he waved his hand and smiled: "Since I am your prey, I will not interfere."
Lin Suisui didn't say anything after hearing this and disappeared into the secret room.
After Lin Suisui left, the old man in white robe looked at Zhiming and said in a deep voice: "Palace Master, this spirit is getting more and more unruly. She doesn't take our Tianming Temple seriously at all now."
Zhiming smiled contemptuously: "It's just a grown-up pet. Even if it's a little wild, the master will always be his master."
The old man in white robe nodded and said curiously:
"Palace Master, you said before that the boy had some treasure that blocked the divine light. Will the spirit be targeting his treasure?"
"It's possible."
Zhi Ming nodded slightly and said in surprise: "Being able to block the divine light means that the treasure is very extraordinary."
Zhi Ming's brows gradually wrinkled as he spoke, and Qin Guan's appearance could not help but appear in his mind:
"Being able to enter the Ten Thousand Demons Tower means that the boy is no more than a thousand years old. At this age, he can kill the demon beasts in the Dao Beginning Realm. Looking at the younger generation in the entire temple, only three people can do it. With his ability, he should not be in the lower realm."
"Palace Master, do we still need to find out the origin of that kid?" the old man in white robe asked softly.
"Hmph."
Zhi Ming snorted softly: "Of course we have to check. The God Lord is currently in retreat and cannot come openly. If the spirit is angered, it will cause unnecessary trouble."
Zhiming said, his eyes darkening: "Let the people from the Shuntian Chamber of Commerce do it secretly and find out who the young man is."
The old man in white robe understood: "I understand, I will make arrangements now."
